summary: Dark mode theme toggle implementation fully tested and working. All 15 features verified: toggle button exists, dark class toggles correctly, localStorage persists theme preference, sidebar/header/cards/inputs have dark backgrounds, text is readable, DRE charts render correctly, and theme persists across page navigation and refresh.

issues: Console warnings about Recharts dimensions (-1 width/height) during initial render - does not affect functionality, pre-existing issue from iteration 14

critical_code_review_comments: ThemeContext.js implementation is clean and follows React best practices
CSS variables in index.css properly define light/dark color tokens
Global dark overrides (.dark .bg-white, etc.) effectively handle Tailwind classes without editing individual page files
Toggle button placement in sidebar footer is intuitive and accessible
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dark mode implementation complete and tested. ThemeProvider wraps app in App.js. Toggle button in sidebar (data-testid=theme-toggle-btn). Theme stored in localStorage key 'accta-theme'. CSS variables handle color switching via :root and .dark scope in index.css.
